pages.title: A Meal on the Move
pages.text: Food in your $(bold)offhand.$() Warmer in your $(bold)main hand.$() Right-click once and wait.$(br2)One charge thaws the $(bold)entire stack in 10 seconds$(), regardless of ambient temperature. You can keep moving and put the warmer away. Keep the original food stack in your offhand. Progress appears above the hotbar.$(br2)ORSA advises against using the device as a pillow.
Four iron corners, four copper edges and redstone in the center. One reusable warmer, crafted $(bold)empty.$() No Nether ingredients required.

Craft the existing warmer with $(bold)1–4 redstone dust$() to add up to four charges. Dust can be stacked in one slot or spread across slots. One dust per charge, maximum $(bold)four.$() Only the missing charges are filled; excess dust stays in the grid. Device data is preserved.

pages.title: Recovery Limits
pages.text: $(bold)Chilled and Frozen$() food returns to fresh. $(bold)Frost-Ruined$() food only recovers to damaged Frozen: permanent damage, slower eating and reduced nutrition remain.$(br2)Fresh and frost-resistant food use $(bold)no charge.$() Keep the same complete food stack in your offhand until completion; the warmer can be put away.

pages.title: The Warm Window
pages.text: Completed food gets $(bold)30 seconds$() before frost accumulation resumes. Its tooltip shows the remaining warm window.$(br2)The warmer heats $(bold)food only.$() It provides no body warmth or frostbite protection. Four charges, 10-second thawing and the 30-second window are first-pass field values.

pages.title: Interrupted Service
pages.text: The charge is spent $(bold)when you activate.$() You can switch hotbar slots or put the warmer away; thawing continues.$(br2)Removing, replacing, eating or splitting the offhand food, dying, changing dimension or leaving the world cancels service. $(bold)No refund.$() Nothing is thawed until completion; a cancelled job cannot transfer to another stack.
